title: a yodel webhook event
description: Version 1. The body yodel apply, yodel plan and yodel drift post to the webhook yodel.config.ts notify names, signed with HMAC-SHA256 over '<x-yodel-timestamp>.<body>' in the x-yodel-signature header. Within a version, fields are only added; a receiver ignores fields it does not know.

id.description: Unique per event; also the x-yodel-delivery header.

status.description: The command's own word for the outcome: gated, refused, denied, failed, incomplete, drifted.

migrations.description: The pending migrations, for apply and plan.

digest.description: The plan digest the run computed.

approve.description: On waiting: the command that approves the plan.

fingerprint.description: The same drift has the same fingerprint run after run, so a receiver can tell a repeat from new drift.
